Episode 323: on air the story is called 'The Lost Sword'; the catalog calls it 'King David's Grave'. Episodes 322 and 320 each have one ASR or narrator slip ('Rabbi Akiva') for the story's hero.

Episode 334: the teacher of the visiting class is introduced as a well-known educator and author of a Chumash primer. He was put in hidden.on_air_people as a precaution; a human should decide whether he counts as a public figure.
